title: I go to my Father
english: Homily on the saying 'I go to my Father' by Cyril, Bishop of Jerusalem, on the verse: 'I go to my Father; and whatever you ask in my name, I will do it, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son' (John 14:14).
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
baehrens: PG Homilia in illud Ego vado ad patrem meum u01-rem-early

title: The Position of the I

title: Distinction of Natures
english: It is a distinction of the natures from the difference of the things being said. And from the fact of conversing in both [ways] it signifies the connection of the person to one single thing.
